headings.usage: Bold, constructed feel for marketing headers and dashboard section titles.

body.usage: Highly readable, technical font for dense BOQ, ERP, and Tender data tables.

mono.usage: For tender IDs, financial figures, BOQ codes, auction timers, and data readouts.

rules: Use 'Safety Orange' (#FF5A1F) sparingly for primary CTAs like 'Place Bid', 'Approve DPR'.
No full-screen gradients. Use matte, solid backgrounds.
Never use pure black or pure gray; tint grays with blue (slate/slate-900) for a steel-like industrial feel.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

marketing.hero: Asymmetric hero with image on right spanning 2 rows, heavy typography on left. Overlay images with bg-black/40.

dashboard.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) + Scoped Navigation Layer
dashboard.structure: Fixed left sidebar (collapsible). Top-left quadrant reserved for North Star Metric. Complex modules use F-pattern.

marketplace.structure: Filter sidebar on left, 3-column product grid on right. Cardless product display with subtle border-b on hover.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Hover state must have subtle -translate-y-0.5 and shadow.

cards.marketing: Grid Borders (Technical look). Exposed skeleton, border-collapse styles.
cards.dashboard: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Hover adds shadow-sm.

components.tables: Shadcn UI table. Dense. Row hover is bg-muted/50. Use floating bulk-action bars.
components.forms: F-pattern layout. Shadcn UI Input/Select. No native inputs. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-primary/20.
components.navigation: Dashboard: Left rail. Marketing: Sticky Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70) with 1px bottom border. DO NOT use transparent.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Rely on 1px borders instead of heavy shadows to maintain 'Industrial' precision.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on dark mode surfaces to simulate raw material (steel/concrete).
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion. Staggered list reveals (0.05s delay per item). Fast snappy transitions for dashboards (0.15s ease-out).
visual_enhancers.3d_libraries: Not recommended for this specific problem statement to keep ERP performance high. Use Recharts for data.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast on all data text. Use tracking-tight on headers.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in all framer-motion configs.

hero_construction.description: Gray metal building frame near tower crane - represents construction and infrastructure

solar_portal.description: Rows of solar panels - represents green energy portal

b2b_materials.description: Rolls of steel lined up - represents B2B vendor marketplace materials

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, recharts, sonner, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Configure Tailwind with CSS variables for the color palette defined in this guide. Set up Dark and Light modes.
Use Shadcn UI for all dashboard elements, forms, and complex interactivity.
For the marketing pages, do not use Shadcn 'Card' wrappers. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for bento grids.
In Dashboards, use `lucide-react` with a stroke width of 1.5px for a technical look.
Ensure the Reverse Auction component has a highly visible monospace countdown timer with immediate visual feedback (e.g., color pulse) on new bids.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, forms, dialogs) to facilitate robust automated testing.
Never use generic centered layouts. Use F-pattern for data density and optical alignment.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and modals. NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use proper SVGs (lucide-react).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap (especially on Marketing site).
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. It is located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Never use generic placeholder text; always use contextual dummy data for BOQ, DPR, and Tender info.
Maintain consistent nested radii: inner elements should have a slightly smaller border radius than their container.
Implement comprehensive loading and error states for heavy data panels (like BOQ or ERP).
